text: dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，在 WebServer 渲染页面时向 head 注入脚本，将 transport 的 ownsHost 标志设为 true。它让经反向代理访问的已认证 Web UI 可以使用 Host 侧功能，例如模型设置和首次配置步骤；脚本合并现有 transport 对象并保留其他字段。插件无需额外密钥或配置，安装后需重启 DSH。

dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback injects a head script into DSH Web that sets the transport ownsHost flag. This enables host-backed features through a reverse proxy while preserving existing transport fields. No extra key or configuration is needed; restart DSH after installation.
想通过反向代理访问 DSH Web 时使用模型设置等 Host 侧功能。
DSH Web 页面被识别为远程页面，怎样启用本机相关功能？
希望非本机地址打开的 DSH 页面也能进入首次 API key 配置步骤。
让 DSH 的 Web 界面在代理后仍显示 Host 支持的设置。
通过代理打开 DSH 后 Host 侧选项不可用，怎么处理？
我想让经代理访问的 DSH Web 页面恢复使用 Host 侧模型管理功能。
How can I use host-backed settings in DSH Web behind a reverse proxy?
Enable the DSH Web UI to treat a proxied page as owning the host.
dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback「代理访问时启用 Host 标志」：在 Web 页面 head 注入脚本，把 transport 的 ownsHost 设为 true，并保留已有字段。
dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback 的功能「接入 WebServer 页面注入」：通过 webServer 服务监听 webserver/index-inject 事件，把脚本追加到页面注入表。
dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback 的功能「无需插件配置」：实现中没有读取配置项或环境变量；安装到 web profile 并重启 DSH 后即可生效。

@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback README · dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback)

A dsh bundle that makes the authenticated Web UI page count as loopback, so
Host-backed settings (Settings → Models, the first-run API-key step, the preview
notice) work when dsh is reached through a reverse proxy instead of `127.0.0.1`.

@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback README · dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback：dsh already authenticates every browser that reaches the Web UI — the
Host/Origin trust fence declared with `--trusted-host` / `trustedHosts`, plus
the browser-session cookie — but it still classifies a non-loopback page as
remote and caps Host-backed features. This bundle flips that one client-side
flag. `ownsHost` is a classification only: the server's authentication and its
Host/Origin fence are untouched.

@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback
```

Restart dsh afterwards.

@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback README · Remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback
```

Restart dsh afterwards.

@exagone313/dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback README · Notes：- No configuration.
- The Host/Origin trust fence is the boundary: only authorities you declared
  trusted should reach the Web UI. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- The `webserver/index-inject` hook belongs to
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`; a future rename would require a plugin
  update.
- Tested against dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`.
